title: Warm Smoky Peruvian Smoked Haddock Ceviche
description: A Peruvian-inspired brunch dish featuring smoked haddock, crispy fried plantains, and a zesty cheese pull, all in a warm and smoky umami flavor profile. This satvik-friendly dish is perfect for a unique brunch gathering.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel the plantains and cut them into 1-inch rounds.
Fry the plantain rounds until they are golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fried plantains on paper towels and set them aside.
In a large bowl, combine the flaked smoked haddock, lime juice, grated cheese, sliced red onion, chopped aji amarillo peppers, chopped cilantro, and minced garlic.
Mix the ingredients together gently until they are just combined.
Add the crispy fried plantains to the bowl and toss them gently with the other ingredients.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the Warm Smoky Peruvian Smoked Haddock Ceviche in small glasses or bowls, garnished with additional chopped cilantro and crispy plantain rounds if desired.
